title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P09: The payoff
summary: Morning. The tree grew while he slept. 'Look! A bird!' BOOM, apples, BONK. 'Years.' Faint.

lines.note: Layla walks in with two mugs (steam). Her scarf is enormous.

lines.text: I wasn't sleeping! I was... resting my eyes.
lines.tts: [startled awake, defensive] I wasn't sleeping! I was... resting my eyes.
lines.note: He jolts up, leaf falls off his face.

lines.tts: [awed, a little hurt] Whoa. It grew... without me.
lines.note: He looks up and up: the young tree is taller than him.

lines.tts: [gently teasing] Mostly because you were asleep.

lines.text: But where are the apples? I want apples. *Now!*
lines.tts: [impatient, whining] But where are the apples? I want apples. Now!
[sly, pointing] Hey, Sam. Look! A bird!
lines.note: MCU Layla points AWAY from the tree (at Pip on the fence): she is helping the tree.
WS: he looks away; behind him the tree BOOMS into a full apple tree (~1.2 s, rumble); an apple drops and BONKS his head.
MS: dazed, holding the apple, little stars orbit his head.

lines.text: Told you. It just needed time.
lines.tts: [warmly, smiling] Told you. It just needed time.
[excited] Okay! Next up: a whole forest!

lines.note: Callback. WS: Sam faints backwards stiff as a board, THUD + dust; Pip lands on his foot.

beats: OPEN (0-3.5 s): morning; birdsong; the young tree; Sam asleep under Layla's blanket, a leaf on his face fluttering with each snore.
l9 gap: the BOOM: full apple tree, apples rain down, one BONKS him, stars orbit his head.
HOLD: Sam faints stiff as a board (THUD + dust), Pip lands on his foot and chirps.
